_meta.title: Docker host (SSH)
_meta.setup: Add the host under SSH hosts first (alias = ssh_host) – this host too, with hostname host.docker.internal. The SSH user must be allowed to run docker (or sudo it: sudo prefix on the SSH host). Compose commands run on the host in the stack's directory.

description: Remote docker host – manage stacks and containers
notes: Default is read – set to write if Claude may change stacks there.
